signals.explanation: Profit after tax increased 27% year-over-year indicating strong profitability.
Automotive segment revenue grew 22% year-over-year reflecting robust demand.
New financing segment incurred a ₹25 crore loss in its first operating period.

parsed.overall_assessment: Bajaj Auto delivered strong revenue and profit growth in FY2024, though its new captive financing subsidiary reported an initial loss and faces aggressive expansion targets.
